snippet.title: Fill Up The Hole I Trailer
snippet.description:
Fill Up The Hole is on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3343160/Fill_Up_The_Hole/

A magical hole gives money whenever something is thrown into it. In this incremental game, create a city and let your peon produce as much garbage as possible to toss in the hole.
